name: Victoria Island Residence
summary: A light-filled two-bedroom residence moments from VI's restaurants and business district.
description: Tall windows, gallery walls and a relaxed palette of tan leather and white linen make this residence feel like home from the moment you arrive. Ideal for families and small groups visiting Lagos for business or leisure.
